---
description: Validate YUNEX mechanical accuracy, image quality, native MP4s and release completeness.
---

Review approved source and narration, exact composition, engineering claims, GLB hierarchy, actual native moving video, wheel/suspension motion, safe zones and codec/frame count. Use `production/tools/quality.py`, `production/studio/studio.py` and `production/phoneqa/phone_qa.py` as appropriate. Record frame-specific defects, fixes and unresolved risks. An Actions green check or image difference alone is not visual approval.
